## Specifications

Fuel kids’ fascination for cool construction site vehicles with this LEGO® City Yellow Bulldozer building toy (60466) for ages 8 and up. This impressive model is packed with realistic features and functions, including a raisable pusher blade and rear dual-shank ripper, plus a detailed engine with visible moving pistons and a spinning cooler fan. The set also includes a construction sign and comes with a driver and 2 worker minifigures for imaginative play.
